scope: Independent read-only review of current implementation diff, public diagnostic guidance, proof-normalization boundary and existing receipts. No new tests, benchmarks or proofs were run. Does not independently replay serial histories or certify whole-engine correctness.

findings.original_issue: Primary-attempt versus abort-cleanup separation could imply that model/adapter cleanup was isolated from the primary delta.
findings.resolution: Current text explicitly includes internal model/adapter cleanup in the primary delta and scopes the separate delta to the additional worker abort.

findings.original_issue: Unqualified on-failure wording implied every killed/crashed/disconnected worker produced complete final counters.
findings.resolution: Current text requires a received worker Error frame, permits absent startup metrics, and states killed workers or broken output streams may produce no final snapshot.

proof_boundary.normalizer: Finite exact guard/call/argument patterns only; unexpected observations reject. Full-source token/site manifest is pinned in the reviewed boundary; current core diff independently restores baseline bytes after only18 guarded observations are removed.
proof_boundary.dependency_freshness: Every declared refinement campaign includes the shared generator. Its normalizer hash pin is checked both during import and by the standalone receipt validator after validating the generator source hash.
proof_boundary.scope: Default-feature component proofs only. The new thread-local observer and feature-enabled timing/interleavings are supported by tests and review, not an implementation-refinement proof. Existing component premises and trusted source adapters remain.
proof_boundary.limitations: Lexical equivalence checks are not a Rust compiler equivalence theorem. Manifest/pin updates remain reviewed trust-boundary changes.

runtime_review.worker_protocol: 129 exhausted failed attempts are counted; only the newest32 samples retained when enabled; dropped count explicit. Disabled mode avoids per-attempt counter-map snapshots. A single Error frame captures aggregate evidence before adapter destruction; retry/backoff and termination behavior remain unchanged.
runtime_review.service_scope: Freshness describes acknowledged cumulative counter coverage only. Transport failures retain stale values with complete=false; no extra error-path metrics RPC, replay authorization or indeterminate-commit resolution is added.
runtime_review.fixture_scope: Partial expiry eligibility is contention-fixture-only, matches active position/outbox/dedup query predicates and PostgreSQL partial index. Both variants use identical marker shape and validate policy plus offsets; original Extended fixture unchanged.
runtime_review.gate_scope: Exact policy/diagnostic companions, bounded trace structure, completed-worker retry reconciliation, and rejection of retained terminal failed attempts are enforced. Missing final failure evidence remains possible and is documented.

performance_review: Public guide claims no speedup, sustainable capacity, physical MMHF result, or 10x result. It distinguishes same-feature-binary runtime on/off cost from compile-time feature cost, demands fixed diagnostic mode for policy comparisons, and retains failed/censored trials. Controlled90-cell completion must not be confused with all90 workloads passing.

final_pilot_status_observed.scope: Status observed during review only; this audit does not assert final pilot completion or passage.

release_note: No implementation/proof-scope blocker found after the two documentation corrections. Final planned validation and archival checks remain separate prerequisites; this review does not waive them.
